description: This file contains utility functions for the Mattermost CLI, including zip file creation, directory zipping, pagination handling, and deep merging of plugin configuration maps.

methods.name: checkInteractiveTerminal
methods.description: Checks if the current stdout is an interactive terminal.

methods.name: zipDir
methods.description: Creates a zip archive from a directory.

methods.name: addToZip
methods.description: Recursively adds files and directories to a zip archive.

methods.name: getPages
methods.description: Retrieves paginated results from a function, aggregating all pages.

methods.name: MergePluginConfigs
methods.description: Deep merges two plugin configuration maps.

methods.name: DeepMergeMaps
methods.description: Recursively merges two maps, with patch values taking precedence.
